turns.question: What share of leads created in September 2026 went on to a booking?
turns.answer: 38.6% of leads created from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 booked within 30 days of being created (lead-to-booking rate 0.3857). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
